title: The Humour Effect
description: Humour makes a message likeable and memorable — and quietly lowers resistance.

sections.title: Quick Understanding
sections.content: A message delivered with humour is liked more, remembered better and resisted less. It works best when the humour is relevant to the point, not bolted on.

sections.title: Why It Works
sections.content: Humour creates positive feeling and a sense of shared ground with the speaker. Good mood reduces counter-arguing, and a light touch makes a serious claim easier to accept.

sections.title: Real-Life Examples
content: A witty advertisement you remember long after a serious one.
A manager opening a difficult message with a warm joke and getting a better reception.

sections.title: What It Looks Like
content: A light, relevant joke attached to a real point.
Warmth that makes a hard message easier to hear.

sections.title: Ethical Uses
sections.content: Humour lowers tension and helps people engage with something uncomfortable.

sections.title: Manipulative Uses
sections.content: Using a joke to smuggle in a claim that would be challenged if stated plainly.

sections.title: Red Flags
content: A serious claim hidden inside a joke.
Humour that discourages you from objecting.

sections.title: Defense Strategies
content: Separate the joke from the argument and judge the argument on its own.

sections.title: Mistakes People Make
content: Letting a friendly tone reduce your scrutiny.

sections.title: Key Lessons
content: Judge the claim apart from the delivery.
